The only Republican elected governor of New York since 1994 was **George Pataki** (first elected Nov 8 1994).  On the ballot he appeared on three lines:

| Ballot line | Party name |
|-------------|------------|
| 1st line | **Republican** |
| 2nd line | **Conservative** |
| 3rd line | **Tax‑Cut‑Now** |

These are the parties listed on the 1994 gubernatorial ballot when Pataki was first elected governor【5†L1-L3】【5†L12-L14】.
